role.en: Co-founder & CEO, Cursor (Anysphere) — a SpaceXAI subsidiary
role.zh: Cursor（Anysphere）联合创始人兼 CEO —— SpaceXAI 子公司

why.en: Cursor became the de-facto standard for AI coding and produced one of the fastest revenue curves in software history from a tiny team — then the largest venture-backed startup acquisition ever recorded.
why.zh: Cursor 成为 AI 编程工具的事实标准，以极小团队实现了软件史上最快的收入增长曲线之一 —— 随后创下有记录以来最大的风险投资支持创业公司收购案。

title.zh: Composer —— Cursor 自研模型

note.en: By late 2025 Composer was handling roughly half of Cursor's autocomplete requests.
note.zh: 到 2025 年底，Composer 已承担 Cursor 约一半的补全请求。

title.zh: Cursor 与今天软件的构建方式

title.zh: Grok Bot for enterprise is out today. We're making it free for all Grok and Cursor enterprise customers for the next two weeks. Deploying Bot has felt like onbo

note.en: Truell announced Grok Bot for enterprise, free for two weeks to Grok and Cursor enterprise customers, comparing the rollout to onboarding thousands of capable teammates.
note.zh: 特鲁埃尔宣布面向企业的Grok Bot上线，向Grok和Cursor企业客户免费开放两周，并将其比作为团队新增了数千名得力的"同事"。

title.zh: Patrick Collison on Stripe’s Early Choices, Smalltalk, and What Comes After Coding

note.zh: Michael Truell在AI + a16z播客中采访Stripe CEO帕特里克·科里森,探讨Stripe早期的技术选择以及AI编程之后的下一步。

title.zh: Michael Truell: How Cursor Builds at the Speed of AI

note.zh: Cursor CEO Michael Truell在a16z播客中讲述团队如何以AI的速度构建和发布产品。

title.zh: 2025 in Review, Cursor Acquires Graphite, TikTok's $50B Profit | Michael Truell & Merrill Lutsky, Pranav Myana, Anna Goldie, Edward Mehr

note.en: Truell appears on TBPN alongside Graphite co-founder Merrill Lutsky to discuss Cursor's acquisition of Graphite and the state of AI coding at the end of 2025.
note.zh: 特鲁尔与 Graphite 联合创始人 Merrill Lutsky 一同做客 TBPN，谈 Cursor 收购 Graphite 以及 2025 年末 AI 编程的格局。

title.en: Stocks Sell Off As More AI, Tech Fears Roil Investors; Cursor CEO on New Valuation 11/13/25
title.zh: Stocks Sell Off As More AI, Tech Fears Roil Investors; Cursor CEO on New Valuation 11/13/25

note.en: Truell appeared on CNBC's Closing Bell to discuss Cursor's new valuation amid a broader tech stock selloff.
note.zh: Truell在CNBC《收盘钟》节目中就科技股抛售背景下Cursor的新估值发表看法。

title.en: After adopting Cursor, businesses merge ~40% more PRs each week. New economics research from the University of Chicago.
title.zh: After adopting Cursor, businesses merge ~40% more PRs each week. New economics research from the University of Chicago.

note.en: Truell cites University of Chicago economics research finding that firms adopting Cursor merge roughly 40% more pull requests per week.
note.zh: 特鲁尔引用芝加哥大学的经济学研究：采用 Cursor 的企业每周合并的 PR 数量增加约 40%。

title.en: Michael Truell: Building Cursor at 23, Taking on GitHub Copilot, and Advice to Engineering Students
title.zh: Michael Truell: Building Cursor at 23, Taking on GitHub Copilot, and Advice to Engineering Students

note.en: Y Combinator fireside talk where Truell retraces founding Cursor at 23, competing with GitHub Copilot, and reaching $100M ARR in a year.
note.zh: Y Combinator 炉边对话：特鲁尔回顾 23 岁创立 Cursor、与 GitHub Copilot 竞争，以及一年内做到 1 亿美元年经常性收入的历程。

title.en: When will we be able to add AI coworkers to Slack to help take on misc operational work? Updating spreadsheets, creating channels, running "cron job" business w
title.zh: When will we be able to add AI coworkers to Slack to help take on misc operational work? Updating spreadsheets, creating channels, running "cron job" business w

note.en: Truell argues publicly for AI coworkers that handle routine operational work inside tools like Slack, sketching where he expects agents to go beyond coding.
note.zh: 特鲁尔公开提出"AI 同事"的设想——在 Slack 等工具中承担日常运营杂务，勾勒出他眼中智能体在编程之外的走向。

title.zh: A conversation with @patrickc on old programming languages, software at industrial scale, and AI's effect on economics/biology/Patrick's daily life. 00:15 - Why

note.en: Truell publishes his conversation with Stripe's Patrick Collison on old programming languages, software at industrial scale, and AI's effect on economics and biology.
note.zh: 特鲁尔发布他与 Stripe 的 Patrick Collison 的对谈，内容涉及老编程语言、工业规模的软件，以及 AI 对经济学与生物学的影响。

title.zh: First Block: Interview with Michael Truell, Co-Founder & CEO of Cursor

note.zh: Notion《First Block》专访特鲁尔，谈 Cursor 早期的关键决策和公司最初几个月的样子。

title.zh: Cursor now supports 1M context-windows, the most expensive models, and unlimited tool calls with API pricing.

note.zh: 特鲁尔宣布 Cursor 支持 100 万 token 上下文窗口、最昂贵的模型，并在 API 计价下不限工具调用次数。

title.zh: The rise of Cursor: The $300M ARR AI tool that engineers can’t stop using | Michael Truell (co-founder and CEO)

note.zh: Lenny 播客专访：Cursor 如何在两年内做到 3 亿美元年经常性收入，以及特鲁尔对 AI 编辑器产品与定价的思考。

title.en: #447 – Cursor Team: Future of Programming with AI
title.zh: #447 – Cursor Team: Future of Programming with AI

note.en: Truell joins fellow Cursor creators Aman Sanger, Arvid Lunnemark and Sualeh Asif on the Lex Fridman Podcast to discuss the future of AI-assisted programming.
note.zh: Truell与Cursor的其他联合创始人Aman Sanger、Arvid Lunnemark和Sualeh Asif一同做客Lex Fridman播客,探讨AI辅助编程的未来。

title.en: SpaceX closes the $60B all-stock acquisition of Anysphere
title.zh: SpaceX 完成 600 亿美元全股票收购 Anysphere

body.en: The largest acquisition of a venture-backed startup on record; ~391M SpaceX Class A shares issued, so founders and backers hold SpaceX paper rather than cash. Cursor becomes a wholly owned subsidiary of the SpaceXAI division with access to Colossus.
body.zh: 有记录以来最大的风险投资支持创业公司收购；发行约 3.91 亿股 SpaceX A 类股，创始人与投资方持有的是 SpaceX 股票而非现金。Cursor 成为 SpaceXAI 部门全资子公司并获得 Colossus 算力。

title.en: ARR passes $2B, three years from founding
title.zh: 成立三年 ARR 突破 20 亿美元

body.en: $100M (Jan 2025) → $500M (Jun 2025) → $1B (Nov 2025) → $2B+ (Feb 2026); enterprise ARR reported around $2.6B with 50,000+ enterprise customers.

title.zh: Michael Truell: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026

body.zh: 《时代》周刊将特鲁尔列入 2026 年"AI 领域最具影响力的 100 人"榜单。

title.en: Michael Truell: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026
title.zh: Michael Truell: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026

body.en: Time Magazine named Michael Truell to its 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026 list, recognizing Cursor's rapid rise.
body.zh: 《时代》杂志将迈克尔·特鲁埃尔列入2026年AI领域最具影响力100人榜单，以表彰Cursor的快速崛起。

title.en: Meet Michael Truell, The 25-Year-Old CEO Whose AI Startup Was Acquired by SpaceX For $60 Billion
title.zh: Meet Michael Truell, The 25-Year-Old CEO Whose AI Startup Was Acquired by SpaceX For $60 Billion

body.en: SpaceX acquired Cursor, the company Truell co-founded and runs, in a deal valued at about $60 billion.
body.zh: SpaceX 以约600亿美元收购了 Michael Truell 联合创办并执掌的 Cursor。

title.en: SpaceX Buys Cursor, Founded By 25-Year-Old Michael Truell, In $60 Billion Deal
title.zh: SpaceX Buys Cursor, Founded By 25-Year-Old Michael Truell, In $60 Billion Deal

body.en: SpaceX acquires Cursor maker Anysphere for $60 billion, the largest venture-backed startup acquisition on record, putting Truell's company under SpaceX.
body.zh: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere，创下风投支持创业公司被收购的最高纪录，特鲁尔的公司自此归入 SpaceX。

title.en: Who Is Michael Truell: The 25-Year-Old Intern Turned Billionaire Behind SpaceX’s $60B AI Deal
title.zh: Who Is Michael Truell: The 25-Year-Old Intern Turned Billionaire Behind SpaceX’s $60B AI Deal

body.en: A profile of Michael Truell traces his path from a 25-year-old intern to the billionaire founder behind Cursor's record $60B acquisition by SpaceXAI.
body.zh: 一篇人物报道讲述了Michael Truell从25岁实习生成长为亿万富翁的经历，他创立的Cursor被SpaceXAI以创纪录的600亿美元收购。
